# Code of conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, and keep discussions about the work.
Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not accepted in issues, pull requests, discussions or
any other project space.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour to [support@sus-ui.dev](mailto:support@sus-ui.dev). Reports are
handled confidentially. The maintainers decide on the response, from a warning to a ban from the
project spaces, following the Contributor Covenant enforcement guidelines.
